    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> N >> M >> P;
    num[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= M; ++i) {
        C[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            num[i] = (num[i] + (long long)num[j - 1] * num[i - j] % P * (i + 1) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;
            int sum = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= i; ++k) {
                sum += abs(j - k);
            }
            V[i] = (V[i] + (long long)V[j - 1] * num[i - j] % P * (i + 1) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]
                    + (long long)V[i - j] * num[j - 1] % P * (i + 1) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]
                    + (long long)num[i - j] * num[j - 1] % P * sum % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P;
        }
    }
    memset(dp, 0, sizeof(dp));
    memset(ans, 0, sizeof(ans));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k + i + 1 <= N + 1 && k + j <= M; ++k) {
                int ni = i + k + 1;
                int nj = j + k;
                long long val = (long long)dp[i][j] * C[M - j][k] % P * num[k] % P;
                dp[ni][nj] = (dp[ni][nj] + val) % P;
                long long add_ans = (long long)ans[i][j] * C[M - j][k] % P * num[k] % P
                                    + (long long)dp[i][j] * C[M - j][k] % P * V[k] % P;
                ans[ni][nj] = (ans[ni][nj] + add_ans) % P;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans[N + 1][M] << "\n";
    return 0;
}
